description: Salary and hourly pay converter — Convert pay between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly and annual (amount= + per=hour|day|week|biweek|semimonth|month|year; hours= per week default 40, days= per week default 5). Also counts the real year (year=): weekdays, observed US federal holidays (holidays=paid|unpaid|none), pto_days=, days and hours actually worked, effective hourly per hour worked, an hourly worker's exact annual pay that year, and overtime rates. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_salary_convert
